verdict_msg: NOVELTY CLAIM REJECTED (Skunkworks vet CONFIRMED by this corrected control): a SINGLE EXISTING binder closes the gap (['ghrr'] -- ghrr = non-commutative correlation, the HRR-family order-sensitive binder excluded from the original control). So 'no single existing closes' was an artifact of testing only commutative binders; the assembled perm-o-xor was COMPOSITIONAL REDISCOVERY of an existing capability (order-sensitive binding), NOT invention. The combine/interpolate MECHANISM is valid (it does assemble order-sensitive closers), but genuine novelty is NOT demonstrated -- the decisive test needs a gap unclosable by the FULL existing operator set. Same rediscovery trap as CELL-INV-1/banach/130a-G2, correctly caught at the decisive moment. order-sensitive conjunctive-binding gap: single-primitive closers=['ghrr'] (must be EMPTY); assembly closers=['perm2_conv', 'perm2_xor', 'perm_conv', 'perm_xor']; abduced MISSING-property=[]; assembly supplies it=False.
